source_text.body:
Handle tenant correspondence end to end
A remote landlord says Claude managed tenant correspondence end to end, handling landlord-tenant messages for a rental property.
·
Jan 10, 2025
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The landlord set up Claude Code on WSL2 with a small Python Gmail CLI that exposed search, thread reading, sending, and replying as shell commands. Claude then searched the tenant’s email thread, read the conversation, opened a Markdown lease, edited the two requested clauses, converted it to PDF with Pandoc, and sent it back; in comments, the poster said they still checked the work.
How it went
The poster says the sequence ran end to end in about two minutes and replaced a process that usually took them days. The thread’s main shortcoming was trust: commenters pushed back hard on letting AI edit and send legal contracts, and the poster later stressed a human still needed to review it.
Worth knowing
The practical catch is that this relied on a roughly 200-line custom Gmail CLI plus contracts already kept in Markdown for Pandoc-based PDF generation.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
I'm a landlord for [property] and the tenant just sent this message: [paste message]. Draft a polite, clear reply consistent with my lease terms: [key lease terms] and local rules in [location]. Tell me if the situation needs a formal notice or professional advice, and give a short log entry for my records. I'll review before anything is sent.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1q7ff1n/i_watched_claude_opus_45_handle_my_tenant
